claims.text: Insufficient information makes it uncertain which material can improve magnetocaloric properties.
Identifying a material with significantly improved magnetocaloric properties would support the stated uncertainty hypothesis.
Failure to identify such a material in a systematic literature review would falsify the stated uncertainty hypothesis.

contradictions.description: Identifying a material that improves magnetocaloric properties would resolve or contradict the claimed uncertainty, not support it. Conversely, failure to identify one would be consistent with insufficient information rather than falsifying that claim.
